# `silent-buffer-truncation`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a void-returning fixed-buffer write that limits its copy with `@min`
without reporting whether all input was written.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Callers cannot distinguish a complete write from silently dropped bytes.

## When it fires

Return a written byte count, return an error on insufficient capacity, or
document and expose truncation through a more precise contract.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const Writer = struct {
    storage: [64]u8 = undefined,
    used: usize = 0,

    fn write(self: *Writer, bytes: []const u8) void {
        const amount = @min(bytes.len, self.storage.len - self.used);
        @memcpy(self.storage[self.used..][0..amount], bytes[0..amount]);
        self.used += amount;
    }
};
```
